'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Garrett Larson DS Set Your Course For Alderaan''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Garrett Larson]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Garrett Larson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
